title: Contracts 1.5: replay_mismatch verify reason (B3-20)
outcome: Decisions-replay mismatches are reported as replay_mismatch, not the misleading hash_mismatch (kabir's B3-20 ruling)
acceptance: replay_mismatch in VERIFY_REASONS (TAMPER), additive minor bump 1.5.0 per the canonical-default rule; 1.3/1.4 runs still verify
ks.verify.decisions uses replay_mismatch for replay and decisions_from mismatches (coordinate with arjun)
summary: Accepted kabir's ruling: VERIFY_REASONS['replay_mismatch'] = Exit.DIVERGED (6), not TAMPER. A replay mismatch means the re-derived decisions differ from the anchored source; it is not evidence of tampering, and exit 2 would tell a jury it was. Exit.DIVERGED comment widened to 're-derived result differs from its source: ks repro A B or a decisions replay'. rundir.py docstring, README 1.5.0 changelog, test_contracts_15 (test_replay_mismatch_is_diverged_not_tamper; TAMPER and WITNESS exits both rejected) updated; decisions.py docstring 'exit TAMPER' -> 'exit DIVERGED' (doc only, code uses VERIFY_REASONS). Still additive (no field, schema or golden change from this). The acceptance line saying TAMPER was my error and is superseded. tests/contracts+verify+cli 469 passed.
review:
[kabir · changes] Additive bump is clean: reason added, schemas only $id, golden only run_config, and 1.3/1.4 fixtures still verify. ONE CHANGE: my B3-20 ruling said replay_mismatch gets its own exit, NOT TAMPER. Exit.TAMPER is documented as 'chain, hash or signature mismatch'. A jury that sees exit 2 on an honest but divergent replay reads it as tampering, which is the exact problem the new reason exists to avoid. The acceptance line was written as TAMPER, contradicting the ruling. Fix: VERIFY_REASONS['replay_mismatch'] = Exit.DIVERGED (6). That is an existing exit meaning 'the re-derivation differs from its source', so no new exit code is needed. Then widen the Exit.DIVERGED comment to 'ks repro A B or a decisions replay: re-derived result differs' and update test_contracts_15 plus the rundir/README text. If maya/PMO want TAMPER anyway, raise it as a decision. Don't override the ruling silently.

[kabir · done] Re-review: fix accepted. VERIFY_REASONS['replay_mismatch'] = Exit.DIVERGED (6); test_contracts_15 rejects TAMPER and WITNESS; hash_mismatch still maps to TAMPER; decisions.py emits replay_mismatch for both the replay check and the decisions_from check. 1.3/1.4 runs still verify (test_additive_13_run, fixtures/run-1.4-world-s0). tests/contracts+verify: 435 passed, 1 skipped (root). The acceptance line that says TAMPER is superseded by the summary. Doc gap, not blocking: ADR-02 and THREAT-MODEL do not mention replay_mismatch or exit 6 at all. They are silent, not contradictory. Follow-up: add 'replay_mismatch -> DIVERGED (6), not tampering' to ADR-02 §6 and to the THREAT-MODEL RT13 row, via THREAT-MODEL-CHANGES.md.
